messages:
Maria - People Ops: Quick heads-up — Liam starts Mon 4/22. Couple logistics: I-9 drop-in vs remote? BG check still pending (TA said 'in progress'). Laptop courier slot needs confirm. Also need a temporary carpool/parking pass for his first week. Need to lock Day 1 schedule (orientation + Sam 1:1).

Jeff - IT: I can handle laptop provisioning and courier. Please confirm shipping address. I’ll set up the temp Slack account and VPN.

Sam - Eng Manager: I’ll do the 1:1 at 2:00pm PT. For I-9, Liam is local so in-person drop-in is fine. @Maria do we have an open slot on Mon morning?

Anna - People Ops: We have I-9 drop-in slots at 9:30 and 11:00 at HQ. If they prefer remote: they need gov ID + selfie upload (secure link). BG check currently shows 'in progress' — no flags so far. For parking pass, ping @Security.

Security Bot: Parking pass request template: please provide "License plate", "Start date", and "Employee name". Internal form: https://redwood.internal/parking-request :lock:

CourierBot: Courier window available Mon 4/22 08:00-10:00. Current hold shpt_12345. Reply with `confirm` to keep slot or `cancel` to release.

Liam - New Hire: Thanks everyone! Address for laptop: 123 Market St, Apt 4C, San Francisco, CA 94103. License plate CA-7ABC123. Prefer 9:30 I-9 slot and 2pm 1:1 works. Confirm courier please.

Maria - People Ops: :thumbsup: thanks Liam. @Jeff please confirm provisioning. I’ll book the 9:30 I-9 drop-in and submit parking request now.

Jeff - IT: Confirmed — provisioning started. Courier hold confirmed (shpt_12345) for 4/22 08:00-10:00. VPN invite and temp Slack creds will be in your email shortly, @Liam.

Anna - People Ops: Calendar invite sent: 9:30 I-9 drop-in (HQ - I-9 Room 2 / Zoom backup). Orientation 10:30-11:30 (intro + benefits overview). Sam 1:1 at 2:00pm PT.

Maria - People Ops: Quick copy of the calendar snippet I added:

```
When: Mon Apr 22 2025 09:30 PDT
Where: HQ - I-9 Room 2 (or Zoom)
Attendees: Liam, Maria, HR Onboarding
Notes: Bring passport OR 2 acceptable IDs for I-9. If remote, use secure upload link.
```

Liam - New Hire: Got it — thanks! I’ll bring my passport. See you Monday.

Maria - People Ops: Awesome, closing the loop. If anything changes ping this thread or DM. :wave:
